contract_md:
- **POST-1** — The input contains exactly five whitespace-separated integers satisfying \(100 \le a \le b \le c \le d \le e \le 2718\). Equal values and both endpoints are allowed.
- **POST-2** — The output contains exactly 31 lines, each containing one nonempty subsequence of `ABCDE`. A name uses each of its letters once, in the order they appear in `ABCDE`.
- **POST-3** — Every participant name appears exactly once. This includes all five single-letter names and `ABCDE`.
- **POST-4** — The scores of the printed participants are nonincreasing. Each score is the sum of the input values corresponding to the letters in the name.
- **POST-5** — Within each group of equal scores, names are in strictly increasing lexicographic order. A proper prefix comes first. Otherwise, the first differing letter determines the order. Names of different lengths can tie.
- **POST-6** — Multiplying all five input scores by the same positive integer preserves the output order whenever the resulting input is valid.
- **POST-7** — Every valid instance has five problem scores and 31 participants. The statement imposes no variable-size time or space requirement.

isolation.mechanism: hardened isolated codex exec (empty tmpdir, read-only, tool flags disabled, credentials stripped, full event-lifecycle audit including item.started)
